rooms.name: Forge Room
rooms.description: A guided production workbench where goals are shaped into tasks, compared across AI roles, and prepared for downstream handoff.

features.name: Forge Workbench
features.description: A coordinator-first planning surface for task drafting, response review, conflict visibility, and synthesis preparation.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUiReady
commandSpecs.description: Signal that the Forge Room UI is attached and ready.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomCreateSession
commandSpecs.description: Create a new local Forge session.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateGoal
commandSpecs.description: Update the active goal draft for the current Forge session.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateOperatorProfile
commandSpecs.description: Persist the Forge operator profile for future runs.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateSessionContext
commandSpecs.description: Store the run-local selection of operator truths that should influence this Forge run.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateRunOverride
commandSpecs.description: Store run-local override values without mutating the persistent operator profile.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomRunPreflight
commandSpecs.description: Build or refresh the run-local preflight bundle.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomClearPreflight
commandSpecs.description: Remove the current run-local preflight result without changing run settings.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomGenerateDraft
commandSpecs.description: Generate a real draft breakdown from the active goal through the Architect seat.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomApplyDraftText
commandSpecs.description: Apply a manually edited draft breakdown payload to the active session.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpsertDraftTask
commandSpecs.description: Create or update a structured draft task without editing the raw JSON payload directly.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomRemoveDraftTask
commandSpecs.description: Remove a structured draft task and its checklist children from the current draft.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomApproveDraft
commandSpecs.description: Promote the current draft tasks into the approved task rail.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateApprovedTask
commandSpecs.description: Adjust dispatch settings for an approved task before queued assignments are sent.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomUpdateContextCapsule
commandSpecs.description: Update an approved task's advanced context capsule before dispatch starts.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomDispatchAssignments
commandSpecs.description: Dispatch queued approved tasks to their assigned seats and capture responses.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomGenerateSynthesis
commandSpecs.description: Generate a synthesis candidate from captured responses and grouped conflicts.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomSelectSynthesis
commandSpecs.description: Mark a synthesis as the selected export candidate.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomSaveSession
commandSpecs.description: Persist the active Forge session to room-local storage.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomLoadSession
commandSpecs.description: Load a selected Forge session from room-local storage.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomLoadLatestSession
commandSpecs.description: Load the most recently updated Forge session from room-local storage.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomDeleteSession
commandSpecs.description: Delete a saved Forge session from room-local storage.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomExportHandoffCheck
commandSpecs.description: Run the handoff export guard for the active Forge session.

commandSpecs.name: ForgeRoomExportHandoff
commandSpecs.description: Export the selected synthesis into a target-room handoff package.

rooms.name: Game Room
rooms.description: A focused board-game room for XOX duels, four-seat Team Tetris matches, and the co-op Fate Knots story-combat skeleton with live AI slots plus the connected US1 remote user.

features.name: XOX
features.description: Three-in-a-row matches against AI1, AI2, or the connected US1 remote user.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomXoxStart
commandSpecs.description: Start a new XOX match from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomXoxReset
commandSpecs.description: Reset the active XOX match state.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomXoxUserMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the user's XOX move from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomXoxAiMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the AI move returned by the selected opponent slot.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomXoxRemoteMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the remote US1 move delivered over room mail transport.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomXoxAcceptInvite
commandSpecs.description: Accept an incoming US1 XOX invite from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomXoxRejectInvite
commandSpecs.description: Reject an incoming US1 XOX invite from the room UI.

features.name: Team Tetris
features.description: A four-seat, turn-based team Tetris mode for the local user, AI1, AI2, and the connected US1 remote user.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisStart
commandSpecs.description: Start a new Team Tetris match from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisReset
commandSpecs.description: Reset the active Team Tetris match state.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisUserMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the local user's Team Tetris path selection from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisAiMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the Team Tetris move returned by AI1 or AI2.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomTeamTetrisRemoteMove
commandSpecs.description: Apply the Team Tetris move delivered over the connected US1 transport.

features.name: Fate Knots
features.description: A shared story-combat skeleton with unanimous party decisions, deterministic AI companions, and one opening encounter.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsStart
commandSpecs.description: Start a new Fate Knots run from the room UI.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsReset
commandSpecs.description: Reset the active Fate Knots run state.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsReady
commandSpecs.description: Lock the local Fate Knots character build and continue the slice.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsCharacterSelect
commandSpecs.description: Apply the local Fate Knots avatar, class, or background selection.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsChoice
commandSpecs.description: Submit the local shared-decision vote for the current Fate Knots step.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsCombatAction
commandSpecs.description: Submit the local combat action for the current Fate Knots turn.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsSync
commandSpecs.description: Recalculate waiting state and retry pending Fate Knots dispatch work.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsEnd
commandSpecs.description: End the current Fate Knots run and return the feature to idle.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsAiChoice
commandSpecs.description: Apply the AI seat vote returned for a Fate Knots decision step.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsAiCombatAction
commandSpecs.description: Apply the AI seat combat action returned for Fate Knots combat.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsRemoteChoice
commandSpecs.description: Apply a US1 Fate Knots decision vote delivered over room transport.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsRemoteCombatAction
commandSpecs.description: Apply a US1 Fate Knots combat action delivered over room transport.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsDmPacket
commandSpecs.description: Store an additive Fate Knots DM narration packet.

commandSpecs.name: GameRoomFateKnotsNpcBanter
commandSpecs.description: Store an additive Fate Knots NPC banter packet.

rooms.name: Laboratory
rooms.description: An obsidian analysis room with a guided workbench for intake, readiness, processing, and reporting across media, audio, and subtitle modules.

features.name: Analysis Workbench
features.description: The unified Laboratory entry point for project intake, readiness review, processing, and reporting across all analysis modules.

features.name: Audio Analysis
features.description: An audio-first analysis desk that reuses the laboratory tool room for source prep, signal checks, speech tooling, and reporting.

features.name: Subtitle Analysis
features.description: A subtitle-first workbench for local subtitle intake, YouTube subtitle capture, cleanup, QC, and reporting.

workbench.label: Laboratory Workbench
workbench.description: A guided desktop workbench that unifies media, audio, and subtitle analysis into one room flow.
